summary: Retest of the iteration 1 fixes. All 4 requested flows pass. (1) Buyer buyer1 logged in, opened /catalog/product/4, clicked Buy now and paid with 4242 on Stripe. Stripe prefilled the email (buyer1@juj.test, read-only contact field) and redirected to the PUBLIC host /checkout/return?order=7&provider=stripe&session_id=..., which then went to /orders/7 showing Paid. No 403. (2) Admin refund on order #7: the order shows Refunded, the Payment attempts row shows Refunded, /admin/payments shows Refunded, and the timeline says 'The order was refunded to the buyer.' (real Stripe refund). (3) With Stripe disabled in /admin/settings, the product page Card button reads 'UNAVAILABLE' and is disabled; unconfigured providers still read 'NOT SET UP'. Stripe was re-enabled through the UI ('Settings saved'). (4) Lockout: nobody@juj.test got 'Wrong email or password.' 5 times, then 'Too many attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.' on the 6th try. The real admin could still log in right after. Backend pytest: 9/9 pass.

minor.issue: Lockout is now keyed by email only. Anyone who knows admin@juj.test can lock the real admin out for 15 minutes by sending 5 wrong passwords (a DoS trade-off). Consider email+trusted-IP, or a CAPTCHA/backoff instead of a hard lock.
Legacy data: order #3, refunded before the fix, still has its tx row as 'paid'. New refunds are correct. Optional one-off data fix.

issues: On first hard load the payment picker can take a few seconds to show; one attempt timed out at 20s on the preview ingress. A reload worked. Likely the preview dev-server, as in iteration 1.

action_items: Optional: rethink email-only lockout (DoS on the known admin email).
Optional: backfill the payment_status of legacy refunded order #3's tx to 'refunded'.
critical_code_review_comments: orders.functions.ts origin() now uses process.env.PUBLIC_APP_URL (non-null assertion). Correct for preview, but set PUBLIC_APP_URL in production too or checkout will build 'undefined/...' URLs.
refundOrder sets the order to refunded before calling the provider. If the provider call fails, the tx stays 'paid' and only a message tells the admin to refund manually. Acceptable.
test_credentials: From /app/memory/test_credentials.md: admin admin@juj.test / JujAdmin2026!, buyer buyer1@juj.test / JujDemo2026!
